## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue
when applicable. Keep source, documentation and commit messages in English.

## Validation

List checks performed on this revision and their results. Distinguish automated,
package and actual hardware/session observations. For hardware, identify the
model, build, bounded test scope and baseline restoration without private data.

## Compatibility

Describe any API, package, data-path or supported-environment impact. Record
unavailable or untested features accurately and preserve contributor attribution.
